# Getting help

- **Using OpenPixo:** start with the [support page](https://openpixo.com/support),
  which covers installing, connecting an AI, credits and common problems.
- **Account, billing or credits:** email **support@openpixo.com** from the
  address you sign in with. Never post payment details or account emails in
  a public issue.
- **Found a bug?** Open a [bug report](../../issues/new?template=bug-report.yml)
  with the version and the steps to reproduce it.
- **Have an idea?** Open a [feature request](../../issues/new?template=feature-request.yml).
- **Security problem:** follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md); please do not
  open a public issue.
